\sphinxAtStartPar
The bioscara arm hardware interface class. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
The hardware interface serves to wrap custom hardware interaction with the arm joints in the standardized ros2\_control architecture.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Hardware Lifecycle} 
The hardware follows the ros2\_control hardware interface lifecyle which intern is following the \sphinxhref{https://github.com/ros2/design/blob/93a415bf928751d37fce6f83215c521658e20c93/articles/node\_lifecycle.md}{ROS2 managed node lifecycle}.

\sphinxAtStartPar

Performs the following checks on the configures joints parsed form the URDF description:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Each joint must have the 3 command interfaces (in this order): ‘position’, ‘velocity’, ‘home’

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Each joint must have the 3 state interfaces (in this order): ‘position’, ‘velocity’, ‘home’

\end{itemize}


\sphinxAtStartPar

Each joint must have these parameters:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
i2c\_address (int, HEX)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
reduction (float)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
min (float)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
max (float)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
stall\_threshold (int, DEC)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
hold\_current (int, DEC)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
drive\_current (int, DEC)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
max\_acceleration (float)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
max\_velocity (float)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
homing\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
speed (float)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
threshold (int, DEC)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
current (int, DEC)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
acceleration (float)

\end{itemize}


\end{itemize}

to enable the joints.

\sphinxAtStartPar
It is allowed to activate the hardware even if it is not homed. To home the joint the homing\_controller must be activated, but generally a hardware component must be active in order for controllers to become active.

 To prohibit movement on activation the set point for each position command interface is set equal to the current measured position, and the velocity command is set to 0.0 for each command interface. The current values are obtained by calling the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1adc34f1df847375abf18fe8100ecec1d1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{read()}}}}} method once which populates the state interfaces with values.

\sphinxAtStartPar

\sphinxAtStartPar
Reads from the hardware and populates the state interfaces. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
Iterates over all state interfaces and calls the corresponding Joint method.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
State interface “position” \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint_1aa48673be56b04a573142ee8c9ad18e20}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::getPosition()}}}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
State interface “velocity” \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint_1a12e554163eb7cb23f6b5b07da4b8705a}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::getVelocity()}}}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
State interface “home” \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1ad010a69043a9ee4578cadeebc85d9c80}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::isHomed()}}}}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
This does not actually trigger a communication, instead it relies on the return flags of the previous transmissions. Since position and velocity have been called immediatly before the return flags are assumed to be valid.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
If the the homing of a joint has been activated through the command interface ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1a412c4e474be5de0820d88b7d1d6084de}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::getCurrentBCmd()}}}}} == {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1affbc9ba6c17b02af32647dc76796de13a93a9a074f04be4b2316dbbca5882b6fa}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::HOME}}}}}) the device signals BUSY ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1a3d59aa860f6b64e6fead60919386f518}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::isBusy()}}}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
) as long as it is still homing.

\sphinxAtStartPar
If the BUSY flag is reset while the current command is still
{\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1affbc9ba6c17b02af32647dc76796de13a93a9a074f04be4b2316dbbca5882b6fa}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::HOME}}}}} we can assume the homing has finished. Then the “home” command interface of the joint is reset to 0.0, which will stop the homing (perform cleanup tasks) at the next write cycle.

\end{itemize}


\end{itemize}

\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Writes commands to the hardware from the command interfaces. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
In contrast to the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1adc34f1df847375abf18fe8100ecec1d1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{read()}}}}} method the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a4ffd7d4e6890f9dfc3d757fb5e3bd5e3}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{write()}}}}} method only loops over the command interfaces that are currently active defined by the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1afc419a32f050cf461e64d958fed917ce}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}} map. See {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a39c1169f5d6bcc8d74b015ba73684096}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{prepare\_command\_mode\_switch()}}}}} for a detailed reasoning why this approach has been chosen.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Command interface “position” \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint_1a8d477e842ea6139ca17fde0af43bc482}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::setPosition()}}}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Command interface “velocity” \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint_1a5b2479210b861c53c3c4e53cf12d75be}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::setVelocity()}}}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Command interface “home” \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1a81b05153ca250ea09930f955ecff09f2}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::startHoming()}}}}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
If the commanded value in “home” is != 0.0 the and the joint is currently executing a blocking function, for example homing ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1a412c4e474be5de0820d88b7d1d6084de}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::getCurrentBCmd()}}}}} == {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1affbc9ba6c17b02af32647dc76796de13ab0bd70c81aace8775e32e0c0e1dfec45}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::NONE}}}}}), the homing sequence is started with the speed, sensitivity, current and acceleration defined in the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a24bfb6fef55ee2a8f659f82ab60b5a4b}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joint\_cfg}}}}} which is polulated from the hardware description urdf. The direction of the homing is determined by the sign of the command interface value.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
If the commanded value in “home” is = 0.0 and the joint is currently executing homing, the homing is stopped. This can either happen prematurely through user input or when the homing is completed which is registered in {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1adc34f1df847375abf18fe8100ecec1d1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{read()}}}}}.

\end{itemize}


\end{itemize}

\begin{fulllineitems}
\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:_CPPv4N28bioscara_hardware_interfaces28bioscara_hardware_interfaces28BioscaraArmHardwareInterface27prepare_command_mode_switchERKNSt6vectorINSt6stringEEERKNSt6vectorINSt6stringEEE}}\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:_CPPv3N28bioscara_hardware_interfaces28bioscara_hardware_interfaces28BioscaraArmHardwareInterface27prepare_command_mode_switchERKNSt6vectorINSt6stringEEERKNSt6vectorINSt6stringEEE}}\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:_CPPv2N28bioscara_hardware_interfaces28bioscara_hardware_interfaces28BioscaraArmHardwareInterface27prepare_command_mode_switchERKNSt6vectorINSt6stringEEERKNSt6vectorINSt6stringEEE}}\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:bioscara_hardware_interfaces::bioscara_hardware_interfaces::BioscaraArmHardwareInterface::prepare_command_mode_switch__std::vector:ss:CR.std::vector:ss:CR}}

\pysigstartmultiline
\pysiglinewithargsret
{\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a39c1169f5d6bcc8d74b015ba73684096}}\DUrole{n}{hardware\_interface}\DUrole{p}{::}\DUrole{n}{return\_type}\DUrole{w}{ }\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{\DUrole{n}{prepare\_command\_mode\_switch}}}}
{\DUrole{k}{const}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{n}{std}\DUrole{p}{::}\DUrole{n}{vector}\DUrole{p}{\textless{}}\DUrole{n}{std}\DUrole{p}{::}\DUrole{n}{string}\DUrole{p}{\textgreater{}}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{p}{\&}\DUrole{n}{\DUrole{sig-param}{start\_interfaces}}\sphinxparamcomma \DUrole{k}{const}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{n}{std}\DUrole{p}{::}\DUrole{n}{vector}\DUrole{p}{\textless{}}\DUrole{n}{std}\DUrole{p}{::}\DUrole{n}{string}\DUrole{p}{\textgreater{}}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{p}{\&}\DUrole{n}{\DUrole{sig-param}{stop\_interfaces}}}
{\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{k}{override}}
\pysigstopmultiline
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Performs checks and book keeping of the active control mode when changing controllers in non\sphinxhyphen{}realtime context. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
For safe operation only one controller may interact with the hardware at the time. For example if the velocity JTC is active and has claimed the velocity command interfaces it is technically possible to activate the position JTC (or a homing controller, or others) that claim a different command interface (position in this case). However if both controllers are active they start writing to the hardware simultaneously which is to be avoided. For this reason a book keeping mechanism has been implemented which stores the currently active command interfaces for each joint in the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1afc419a32f050cf461e64d958fed917ce}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
member. Each joint has a set of active command interfaces. When a controller switch is performed the interfaces that should be stopped are removed from each joint set, then the one that should be started are added, if they are already present an error is thrown. Lastly a validation is performed. Currently the validation is simple since each joint may only have one command interface. The validation can be expanded for furture use cases that require a combination of active command interfaces per joint for example.

\sphinxAtStartPar
The following basic checks are implemented:
\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{On deactivation}:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}ERROR{]} Homing command interfaces may only be deactivated if no current homing process is ongoing ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1a412c4e474be5de0820d88b7d1d6084de}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::getCurrentBCmd()}}}}} != {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1affbc9ba6c17b02af32647dc76796de13a93a9a074f04be4b2316dbbca5882b6fa}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::HOME}}}}})

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}WARN{]} Deactivating a velocity command interface if the velocity set point is 0.0.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}WARN{]} Deactivating a command interface that has not been started. This should not happen.

\end{itemize}


\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{On activation}:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}ERROR{]} Activating a command interface that is already started. This should not happen.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}ERROR{]} Activating a second command interface for a joint.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}ERROR{]} Activating ‘position’ or ‘velocity’ command interface if the joint is not homed ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1ad010a69043a9ee4578cadeebc85d9c80}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::isHomed()}}}}} == false).

\end{itemize}


\end{itemize}

Since this method operates in non\sphinxhyphen{}realtime context it must not access critical members ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1afc419a32f050cf461e64d958fed917ce}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}} and {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a99e93a65247944cf62e75767ba98a656}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joints}}}}}) to avoid priority inversion. Therefore the new command modes are first saved to a cache {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a222af12f49df8ea14f9d0d44a92e9617}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_new\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}}. This will then be applied to {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1afc419a32f050cf461e64d958fed917ce}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}} in the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a06406f562da286f933b52b6e7009bd7f}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{perform\_command\_mode\_switch()}}}}} which is executed in RT context.
\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{start\_interfaces}} \textendash{} command interfaces that should be started in the form “joint/interface” 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{stop\_interfaces}} \textendash{} command interfaces that should be stopped in the form “joint/interface” 

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
hardware\_interface::return\_type 

\end{description}\end{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Perform the mode\sphinxhyphen{}switching for the new command interface combination in realtime context. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
Performs the following actions:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
acquires the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1ae6ab09796fe5fe402f63f6769670eea3}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{mtx}}}}} lock to protect the critical members.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Copies the cached {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a222af12f49df8ea14f9d0d44a92e9617}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_new\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}} to the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1afc419a32f050cf461e64d958fed917ce}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{On activation}:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{home} interface:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Reset command to 0.0. This clears any remaining commands that have been written to the command interface while the hardware was unable to act on it. For example if it was inactive or the homing command was not the active command mode.

\end{itemize}


\end{itemize}


\end{itemize}

\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{start\_interfaces}} \textendash{} vector of string identifiers for the command interfaces starting. 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{stop\_interfaces}} \textendash{} vector of string identifiers for the command interfaces stopping. 

\end{itemize}

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
return\_type::OK if the new command interface combination can be switched to (or) if the interface key is not relevant to this system. Returns return\_type::ERROR otherwise. 

\end{description}\end{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Called when an error in any state or state transition is thrown. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
According to the \sphinxhref{https://control.ros.org/jazzy/doc/ros2\_control/hardware\_interface/doc/hardware\_components\_userdoc.html\#handling-of-errors-that-happen-during-read-and-write-calls}{ros2\_control documentation}:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\begin{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Error handling follows the node lifecycle. If successful CallbackReturn::SUCCESS is returned and hardware is again in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{UNCONFIGURED}} state, if any ERROR or FAILURE happens the hardware ends in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{FINALIZED}} state and can not be recovered. The only option is to reload the complete plugin, but there is currently no service for this in the Controller Manager. 
\end{quote}


\sphinxAtStartPar
Since the hardware will immediatly return to the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{unconfigured}} state (\sphinxhref{https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2\_control/blob/d0836b7f12b89acb89bde83d4ba4308513b03204/hardware\_interface/src/hardware\_component.cpp\#L247}{source}) if the error could be handled we manually call the transition functions which would normally be called to this state. Those are:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Previous state}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{active}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Deactivate hardware ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1ab126441df1ddd42eee72667dd3d91301}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_deactivate()}}}}}) \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{inactive}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Clean\sphinxhyphen{}Up hardware ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a1bec98b0fd955e1403ebc224e3562082}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_cleanup()}}}}}) \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{unconfigured}}

\end{itemize}


\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Previous state}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{inactive}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Deactivate hardware ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1ab126441df1ddd42eee72667dd3d91301}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_deactivate()}}}}}) \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{inactive}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
call the deactivate function anyway regardless if state was active or inactive. For example if the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a98236f8d72f1937774358eb326c4e795}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_activate()}}}}} function fails on {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint_1a203608e60cc83c2078edf0c3a4a68dbe}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{bioscara\_hardware\_drivers::Joint::enableStallguard()}}}}} the joint will have been enabled, to disable it invoke {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1ab126441df1ddd42eee72667dd3d91301}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_deactivate()}}}}}.

\end{itemize}


\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Clean\sphinxhyphen{}Up hardware ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a1bec98b0fd955e1403ebc224e3562082}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_cleanup()}}}}}) \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{unconfigured}}

\end{itemize}


\end{itemize}

In particular the deactivation is important. For example if a joint stalls the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1adc34f1df847375abf18fe8100ecec1d1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{read()}}}}} or {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a4ffd7d4e6890f9dfc3d757fb5e3bd5e3}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{write()}}}}} methods throw an error, which will be handled here and allow the hardware to be deactivated, disableing the joints to allow backdriving.

\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{previous\_state}} \textendash{} 

\sphinxlineitem{Returns}
\sphinxAtStartPar
hardware\_interface::CallbackReturn 

\end{description}\end{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
unordered map storing the pointers to BaseJoint objects. This will either be a MockJoint or Joint. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
An unordered map is chosen to simplify acces via the joint name, as this conforms well with the ROS2\_control hardware interface The map does not need to be ordered. Search, insertion, and removal of elements have average constant\sphinxhyphen{}time complexity.

\sphinxAtStartPar
Since the BaseJoint methods are implemented as virtual, dynamic method dispatch can be utilized to call the correct implementation of a method. So either BaseJoint::foo() or Joint::foo()/MockJoint::foo() if foo() is overwritten in Joint or MockJoint. a smart pointer is used to guarantee destruction when the pointer is destructed. A unique pointer is used to prevent copying of the object. 

\end{fulllineitems}

\sphinxAtStartPar
unordered map of sets storing the active command interfaces for each joint. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
Each joint can have a set of active command interfaces. This type of structure is chosen to group interfaces by joint. In the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a4ffd7d4e6890f9dfc3d757fb5e3bd5e3}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{write()}}}}} function the interface name can simply be constructed by concatenating joint name with interface name. Although currently only one active command interface is allowed at the time, a set can be used to store multiple command interfaces that are acceptable to be combined, for example it would be acceptable to set velocity and driver current and hence that would be an allowable combination.

\sphinxAtStartPar
An unordered map is chosen to simplify acces via the joint name, as this conforms well with the ROS2\_control hardware interface. The map does not need to be ordered. Search, insertion, and removal of elements have average constant\sphinxhyphen{}time complexity. 

\end{fulllineitems}

\sphinxAtStartPar
A vector of a pair of interface name and pointer of the hardwares state interface which is ordered by joint and state interface type. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
A vector is chosen since it guarantees the correct order by insertion. The vector holds pointers to the actual interface structs stored in the parents HardwareComponentInterface::joint\_state\_interfaces\_ but in the desired order. The order is:\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\roman}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
position

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
velocity

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
home

\end{enumerate}


\sphinxAtStartPar
This order guarantees that when reading the state interfaces in {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1adc34f1df847375abf18fe8100ecec1d1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{read()}}}}} that the ‘home’ interface is read last and has the latest state flags from the joint. 

\end{fulllineitems}

\pysigstopmultiline
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
A mutex that is used to prevent concurrent access to hardware and {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1afc419a32f050cf461e64d958fed917ce}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}}. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
The mutex prevents two things:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Modifying the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1afc419a32f050cf461e64d958fed917ce}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joint\_command\_modes}}}}} concurrently.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Concurrent access to the hardware via the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a99e93a65247944cf62e75767ba98a656}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{\_joints}}}}} map. The Joint harwdare is not thread safe. In particular the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1adc34f1df847375abf18fe8100ecec1d1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{read()}}}}} and {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a4ffd7d4e6890f9dfc3d757fb5e3bd5e3}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{write()}}}}} methods are executed in one RT thread while the {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a06406f562da286f933b52b6e7009bd7f}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{perform\_command\_mode\_switch()}}}}} is called from another RT thread. The latter also tries to modify the Joint object via {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1aacfb3f227b2e2e5ab0d4aaa6e6790771}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{activate\_joint()}}}}} and {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1ae2dd8ba9d468f31f98338ebbd3e3c9c7}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{deactivate\_joint()}}}}} which must not happen concurrently with a {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1adc34f1df847375abf18fe8100ecec1d1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{read()}}}}} or {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1a4ffd7d4e6890f9dfc3d757fb5e3bd5e3}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{write()}}}}} call.

\end{itemize}


\sphinxAtStartPar
All methods that need to acquire this lock need to be performed in RT context to avoid being preempted by other lower priority threads potentially blocking the other RT threads from continuing. 

\end{fulllineitems}

\pysigline
{\phantomsection\label{\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:structbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraArmHardwareInterface_1_1joint__config__t_1a0a84f3e1768fbfb9da1952812a8ea644}}\DUrole{kt}{float}\DUrole{w}{ }\sphinxbfcode{\sphinxupquote{\DUrole{n}{reduction}}}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{p}{=}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{m}{1}}
\pysigstopmultiline
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
{[}float{]} Gear reduction of the joint 

\sphinxAtStartPar

\sphinxAtStartPar
This is used to transform position and velocity values between in joint units and actuator (stepper) units. The sign depends on the direction the motor is mounted and is turning. Adjust such that the joint moves in the positive direction on on positive joint commands. Cable polarity has no effect since the motors automatically adjust to always run in the ‘right’ direction from their point of view.

\sphinxAtStartPar
J1: 35

\sphinxAtStartPar
J2: \sphinxhyphen{}2*pi/0.004 (4 mm linear movement per stepper revolution, positive rotation makes the joint go down (negative), hence the minus sign for correction)

\sphinxAtStartPar
J3: 24

J4: 12 

\end{fulllineitems}

{\DUrole{k}{const}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{n}{rclcpp\_lifecycle}\DUrole{p}{::}\DUrole{n}{State}\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{p}{\&}\DUrole{n}{\DUrole{sig-param}{previous\_state}}}
{\DUrole{w}{ }\DUrole{k}{override}}
\pysigstopmultiline
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Called when an error in any state or state transition is thrown. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
According to the \sphinxhref{https://control.ros.org/jazzy/doc/ros2\_control/hardware\_interface/doc/hardware\_components\_userdoc.html\#handling-of-errors-that-happen-during-read-and-write-calls}{ros2\_control documentation}:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\begin{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Error handling follows the node lifecycle. If successful CallbackReturn::SUCCESS is returned and hardware is again in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{UNCONFIGURED}} state, if any ERROR or FAILURE happens the hardware ends in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{FINALIZED}} state and can not be recovered. The only option is to reload the complete plugin, but there is currently no service for this in the Controller Manager. 
\end{quote}


\sphinxAtStartPar
Since the hardware will immediatly return to the \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{unconfigured}} state (\sphinxhref{https://github.com/ros-controls/ros2\_control/blob/d0836b7f12b89acb89bde83d4ba4308513b03204/hardware\_interface/src/hardware\_component.cpp\#L247}{source}) if the error could be handled we manually call the transition functions which would normally be called to this state. Those are:\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Previous state}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{active}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Deactivate hardware ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraGripperHardwareInterface_1ab199edb3ee4a278fc8f5a24c2536fc14}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_deactivate()}}}}}) \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{inactive}}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Clean\sphinxhyphen{}Up hardware ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraGripperHardwareInterface_1a5adcd99396a192989faaaaea5aeeffc1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_cleanup()}}}}}) \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{unconfigured}}

\end{itemize}


\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Previous state}: \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{inactive}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Deactivate hardware ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraGripperHardwareInterface_1ab199edb3ee4a278fc8f5a24c2536fc14}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_deactivate()}}}}}) \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{inactive}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
call the deactivate function anyway regardless if state was active or inactive.

\end{itemize}


\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Clean\sphinxhyphen{}Up hardware ({\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_interfaces/index:classbioscara__hardware__interfaces_1_1BioscaraGripperHardwareInterface_1a5adcd99396a192989faaaaea5aeeffc1}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{on\_cleanup()}}}}}) \sphinxhyphen{}\textgreater{} \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{unconfigured}}

\end{itemize}


\end{itemize}

\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{previous\_state}} \textendash{}

hardware\_interface::CallbackReturn 

\end{description}\end{quote}

\pysigstopmultiline
\pysigstopsignatures
\sphinxAtStartPar
Construct a new {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseGripper}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{BaseGripper}}}}} object. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
The gripper has the reduction \(r\) and offset \(o\) parameters which are used to translate from a desired gripper width to the servo angle. The relationship between gripper width \(w\) and acutator angle \(\alpha\) is as follows:  \begin{equation*}
\begin{split}
  \alpha = r (w-o)
  \end{split}
\end{equation*}

\sphinxAtStartPar
To determine these parameters execute the following steps:

\sphinxAtStartPar
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\roman}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Manually set the gripper to an open position by setting a actuator angle. Be carefull to not exceed the physical limits of the gripper since the actuator is strong enough to break PLA before stalling.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Measure the gripper width \(w_1\) and note the set actuator angle \(\alpha_1\).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Move the gripper to a more closed position that still allows you to accurately measure the width

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Measure the second width \(w_2\) and note the corresponding angle \(\alpha_2\)

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate the offset \(o\):  \begin{equation*}
\begin{split}
  o = \frac{\alpha_1 w_2 -  \alpha_2 w_1}{\alpha_1 - \alpha_2}
  \end{split}
\end{equation*}

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Calculate the reduction \(r\):  \begin{equation*}
\begin{split}
  r = \frac{\alpha_1}{w_1 - o}
  \end{split}
\end{equation*}

\end{enumerate}

\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{reduction}} \textendash{} the gripper width to actuator reduction ratio 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{offset}} \textendash{} gripper width to actuator zero offset 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{min}} \textendash{} lower limit in m 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{max}} \textendash{} upper limit in m 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{backup\_init\_pos}} \textendash{} initial position assumed if none can be retrieved from the buffer file 

\end{itemize}

\end{description}\end{quote}

\end{fulllineitems}

Enable encoder stall detection of the joint. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
If the PID error exceeds the set threshold a stall is triggered and the motor disabled. A detected stall can be reset by homing or reenabling the joint using {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1BaseJoint_1ab71c7a70946252c09efbd42b039b7eb0}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{enable()}}}}}. 

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar

Create a {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{Joint}}}}} object. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
The {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{Joint}}}}} object represents a single joint and its actuator. Each {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{Joint}}}}} has a transmission with the following relationship: \begin{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar

\sphinxAtStartPar
actuator position = (joint position \sphinxhyphen{} offset) * reduction

\sphinxAtStartPar
joint position = actuator position / reduction + offset

\end{quote}

\begin{quote}\begin{description}
\sphinxlineitem{Parameters}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{name}} \textendash{} string device name for identification 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{address}} \textendash{} 1\sphinxhyphen{}byte I2C device adress (0x11 … 0x14) for J1 … J4 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{reduction}} \textendash{} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
gear reduction of the joint. This is used to transform position and velocity values between in joint units and actuator (stepper) units. The sign depends on the direction the motor is mounted and is turning. Adjust such that the joint moves in the positive direction on on positive joint commands. Cable polarity has no effect since the motors automatically adjust to always run in the ‘right’ direction from their point of view.

\sphinxAtStartPar
J1: 35

\sphinxAtStartPar
J2: \sphinxhyphen{}2*pi/0.004 (4 mm linear movement per stepper revolution)

\sphinxAtStartPar
J3: 24

J4: 12 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{min}} \textendash{} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
lower joint limit in joint units.

\sphinxAtStartPar
J1: \sphinxhyphen{}3.04647

\sphinxAtStartPar
J2: \sphinxhyphen{}0.0016

\sphinxAtStartPar
J3: \sphinxhyphen{}2.62672

J4: \sphinxhyphen{}3.01069 

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstyleliteralstrong{\sphinxupquote{max}} \textendash{} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
upper joint limit in joint units.

\sphinxAtStartPar
J1: 3.04647

\sphinxAtStartPar
J2: 0.3380

\sphinxAtStartPar
J3: 2.62672

J4: 3.01069 

\end{itemize}

\end{description}\end{quote}

\sphinxAtStartPar
Enable encoder stall detection of the joint. 

\sphinxAtStartPar
If the PID error exceeds the set threshold a stall is triggered and the motor disabled. A detected stall can be reset by homing or reenabling the joint using {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint_1a4fba72ada8234cb624658560a3c40530}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{enable()}}}}}. 

\begin{sphinxadmonition}{note}{Note:}
\sphinxAtStartPar
If stall detection shall be enabled, invoke this method AFTER enabling the joint with {\hyperref[\detokenize{code/bioscara_hardware_drivers/index:classbioscara__hardware__drivers_1_1Joint_1a4fba72ada8234cb624658560a3c40530}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{std}{\DUrole{std-ref}{enable()}}}}}.
